patterns.catalog: ai-tells command: writing; ai-tells-3 patterns G, T
patterns.fix: Rewrite so no dash is needed: split into two sentences, or use a colon, comma, or plain hyphen.
State the fact, step, or decision directly; drop the author's voice. Keith's own words pass verbatim.

hit: I'd start with a small set of packages.
My recommendation is to start now.
clean: Start with a small set of packages.

patterns.fix: Decide and state the decision ('Use path 1'), or drop the line when the choice is obvious.

hit: Fix the three titles (recommended for the first push).
clean: The recommended dose is two tablets.

patterns.fix: Use regular case; let sentence structure carry the emphasis.

hit: Title is correct; do NOT add the prefix.
clean: Title is correct; do not add the prefix.

patterns.fix: Open with the content; drop the opener.

hit: Yes. The draft is strong on provenance.

patterns.message: Signposts importance instead of showing it
patterns.fix: State the distinction or detail itself; drop the announcement.

hit: The important distinction is that data differs from methods.

patterns.fix: Name the topic of the section instead.
State what to do or what is true; drop the conditional.

hit: What would make it more impressive is a baseline.

patterns.fix: State the limit as a plain sentence.

hit: A caveat: the tool is not a reservoir simulator.
clean: The tool is not a reservoir simulator.

patterns.message: Announces that the request was met
patterns.fix: Describe the thing itself; request tracking belongs in the tracker or session notes.

hit: You asked whether readers could listen at their own pace.
clean: Press play and the post reads itself aloud.

patterns.fix: Keep a date only when the reader needs it, stated once in one place; otherwise state the fact.

patterns.pattern: \b(?:this|it) may already (?:be )?(?:done|live|exist)|\bmay already be\b|\blooks (?:done|fine|ok) in production\b|\bcould go either way\b
patterns.fix: Check and state the fact, or write 'Pending: <what is being checked>'.

patterns.pattern: ^(?:Confirm|Verify|Decide)\b(?: with| whether| if| that| on| once|:)
patterns.message: Question or task deferred to the reader
patterns.fix: Answer it, or state the next step with its owner.

hit: Confirm with the client, then delete.
Verify whether this is a duplicate.

patterns.message: Imperative addressed to the author's future self
patterns.fix: State the policy or decision as a fact.

clean: Title changes go to production after client approval.

patterns.pattern: \b(?:in this session|this round|this pass|the earlier discussion|previous (?:draft|version|iteration)|earlier draft)\b
patterns.fix: Describe the content; leave process history to the changelog.

hit: The earlier discussion of FloPy covers groundwater.

patterns.fix: Say what the thing is; drop what it is not.

hit: A reduced model, not a forecast.

patterns.message: Refers to the tool that wrote the text
patterns.fix: Remove the reference.

patterns.pattern: \b(?:edits were surgical|no file rewrites|i have not (?:pushed|run|seen|executed|tested)|all work stays in this folder|nothing was (?:deleted|pushed|changed)|no deletions?)\b
patterns.message: Recites a rule that was followed
patterns.fix: Describe what was done; the diff shows how.

patterns.message: Announces the content before giving it
patterns.fix: Start with the content.

hit: Here is the running URL list.
clean: The URL list follows by source weight.

patterns.fix: Pick one outcome, or name the condition that decides.

clean: Either the file or the folder.

patterns.message: Cites where the data came from instead of the data
patterns.fix: State the fact itself; put provenance in a note when it matters.

hit: The production JSON snapshot shows a short title.

patterns.message: Heading joins a title to an appended half
patterns.fix: Fold the appended element into the title's grammar, or cut it when it is only a hook.
Three or more suggests the whole document is machine-authored: decide each item and state it.
Three or more suggests machine authorship: rewrite the emphasized sentences in regular case.
